assets.prompt: Create one genuinely transparent six-cell production sprite atlas for a first-grade Chinese delivery and listening lesson. Exactly 3 equal columns × 2 equal rows of square cells, overall 3:2 landscape. Every sprite is separate and centered with all margins and gutters alpha zero, no texture outside the object. Use exactly this order. Top left: a single complete golden-yellow oval fall leaf, short stalk and simple midrib, tilted up-right. Top middle: the exact same silhouette, size, tilt and stalk as the yellow leaf, but solid fresh medium green. Top right: one red knitted scarf laid out as a long horizontal soft strip with visible short fringe at both ends, front-three-quarter view, moderately saturated warm red. Bottom left: the exact same long horizontal scarf with same scale and fringe, clear medium blue instead of red. Bottom middle: one medium-blue round knitted cap with visibly rounded crown and broad knitted cuff, side-three-quarter view, a compact round silhouette clearly unlike a scarf, no pom-pom or logo. Bottom right: one medium-green round yarn ball, simple distinct curved yarn strands and a single short loose end, no other accessory. Original fine paper grain, matte gouache and crisp paper-cut edges, low-detail silhouettes intentionally recognizable at 30px. Keep the scarf and cap blue vivid and clearly different in silhouette. Flat crisp opacity, empty true transparent outer area, no blur, glow, shadow, grid, text, letters, numbers, watermark, logos, people, or background.
